evidence: Labeled 'Mining' and modifies `BlockTemplateManager` (`src/node/block_template_manager.cpp`) along with the mining interface to track block template memory usage.
rationale: Provides visibility and control over memory pinned by external mining clients holding stale block templates with evicted mempool transactions. Reviewers note this is strategically valuable for hardening the mining interface and tracking resource usage for downstream consumers such as Stratum v2.
